column1: # mapping_set_description: Spanish grades, stages, insignia, ceremonies and offices (the Order of Charles III, the tuna, the cofradías) placed under the generic chivalric grades, stages, insignia types, ceremony types and office types.

column8: The lowest grade; the generic ladder has no cross, and the knight is the nearest entry grade.
The grade between Encomienda and Gran Cruz.
The highest grade, worn with a collar.
The first stage of a candidate.
The second candidate stage, in the tunas that have one.
A band worn in a V over the chest and shoulders, in the colour of the faculty.
The cape or manteo of the tuno's costume.
The ceremony that recognises a candidate as a tuno.
The act of admission into a cofradía.
The public procession of a penitential cofradía in Holy Week.
The president of a cofradía or hermandad.
